activity.notes: Quezon took office as the first President of the Commonwealth of the Philippines on 15 November 1935 and remained constitutional president, including during the wartime government-in-exile, until his death on 1 August 1944.

sources.title: Blue book of the inauguration of the Commonwealth of the Philippines — Philippine eLib
sources.citation_text: The Philippine eLib catalog records the inauguration of the Commonwealth and induction of Manuel L. Quezon as first president on 15 November 1935.

sources.title: Executive Order No. 9-W, 2 February 1944 — Supreme Court E-Library
sources.citation_text: A wartime executive order issued in Washington in February 1944 documents Quezon continuing to exercise the presidency of the Commonwealth shortly before his death.
